comment.narrative: The government still have the tendency to uphold the coalfired power plant and heavy in austral estate in Southern Thailand
The government reconsider energy plan and other development plan of Southern Thailand in alignment with SDGs.

The study of SEA on coal power plants in the South of Thailand by NIDA has its conclusion to support natural gas and renewable energy as the first choice. The full official report will be released in the first quarter of 2022.
